## What would you like?

A clear description of the feature or improvement you have in mind.

## What problem does it solve?

What are you trying to do that is hard or impossible today? Who does it help?

## How would you expect it to work?

Describe the experience you would want. Screens, steps, or a rough sketch are all welcome.

## Anything else

Alternatives you have considered, related toys or states, or any other context.
